key_test: 2x2 between-groups ANOVA (Condition_Game x Condition_Communication) on group-mean GivePool_B (40 groups of 3); key term = Condition_Game main effect F(1,36); partial eta^2 = SS_game/(SS_game+SS_error)
exclusions: none; aggregation of 120 participants to 40 groups

r_script.why: package missing: dplyr is not installed in R 4.6.2 (foreign is present); the script also sources getOSFfile.R from an external URL

agreement: table and Python agree (F 26.76, df 1/36, partial eta^2 .426; p 8.84e-06 vs the table's recalculated 8.85e-06, the table's 1e-04 is a floor). Cross-check on the team's aggregated file (Pool_B_Percent, the DV of their SPSS UNIANOVA, type III) gives the same F. R script not run.
notes: Anchored on the replication report (key term chosen by the original author: game main effect on pool B) and the script, which agree. Balanced design (10 groups per cell), so type I and type III SS coincide. Other terms: communication F=0.16, interaction F=0.21, matching the report's Table 1. Means: 5.15 tokens to pool B in IPD vs 1.53 in IPD-MD. N.R counts participants (120) while df uses groups (40). The two groups of a cohort play each other (Group6 in the aggregated file), so groups are not strictly independent; neither the team nor the audit models this. Second plausible test: IPD-MD only, communication effect on pool W (report: t(18) = -1.17, p = .254); not recomputed.
